basis: Approved revised-s1-s2 plan a6046ff; expectations authored independently before implementation review.

cases.full: Initial response contains product information in inspectable source.
cases.partial: Initial source contains some product information but material product information is deferred or inaccessible.
cases.failure: A complete initial response is a shell without product information.
cases.unmeasured: Response unavailable, truncated before evidence, or inspection unsupported.

cases.full: Product information is available as ordinary readable source text.
cases.partial: Some product information is readable while other observed information is image-only or otherwise not ordinary text.
cases.failure: Observed product information is exclusively image-only or inaccessible to ordinary source-text extraction.
cases.unmeasured: Insufficient source evidence to determine its representation.

cases.full: Source evidence clearly associates product information with the audited product.
cases.partial: Product information is present but its association with the audited product is ambiguous.
cases.failure: Complete evidence establishes that available product information concerns another product.
cases.unmeasured: No reliable product association can be determined from incomplete or unsupported evidence.

cases.full: Source identifies the selected configuration where configuration selection applies.
cases.partial: Source gives observed but ambiguous selected-configuration evidence.
cases.failure: Complete source establishes a required selection without identifying the selected configuration.
cases.NA: Explicit evidence establishes exactly one configuration and no dependent values.
cases.unmeasured: Missing or incomplete evidence does not establish selection or the conditions for exclusion.

cases.full: All referenced supporting resources inspected are accessible.
cases.partial: Referenced resources include both accessible and confirmed inaccessible resources.
cases.failure: Referenced supporting resources are confirmed broken or require login and none are accessible.
cases.NA: Complete evidence establishes no supporting resources are referenced.
cases.unmeasured: A referenced resource times out, inspection is unsupported, or evidence is truncated such that access cannot be determined.

cases.full: Recognized structured markup parses and observed types and formats are valid.
cases.partial: Some recognized markup is valid and some observed markup has syntax, type, or format defects.
cases.failure: Complete inspection finds no markup or only malformed or invalid markup.
cases.unmeasured: Truncation or unsupported inspection prevents reliable assessment.

cases.full: A product entity is clearly associated with the audited product page.
cases.partial: An observed product entity has ambiguous page association.
cases.failure: Complete inspection finds no product entity or establishes that it describes another product.
cases.unmeasured: Inspection cannot reliably establish whether an associated entity exists.

cases.full: An Offer is correctly connected to the product or variant with internally coherent price, currency, and availability fields.
cases.partial: An observed Offer has usable but incomplete information or an ambiguous association, including a typed embedded Offer without commercial fields.
cases.failure: Complete inspection establishes a missing associated Offer, wrong-product connection, or unusable contradiction.
cases.unmeasured: Incomplete or unsupported inspection prevents determining the offer connection.

cases.full: Provided applicable identifiers are appropriately modeled and valid.
cases.partial: Observed identifier evidence is incomplete or limited to a merchant SKU.
cases.failure: Complete inspection establishes missing applicable identifiers or invalid supplied identifier values.
cases.NA: Explicit evidence establishes none are assigned and no external identifier is supplied.
cases.unmeasured: Missing evidence alone does not establish that identifiers are unassigned.

cases.full: Applicable parent-family relationships and distinguishing variant attributes are correctly modeled.
cases.partial: Observed variant relationships exist but are ambiguous or incomplete.
cases.failure: Complete evidence establishes applicable variants are missing or incorrectly related.
cases.unmeasured: Absence of evidence alone does not establish no variants.

crossChecks: Missing product markup is not NA for syntax, entity, offer, identifiers, or variants; conditional exclusions require their own explicit evidence.
Offer is always applicable under current merchant categories.
Unknown is never NA or a confirmed failure; ambiguity earns partial only when observed.
Changing shopper-content completeness alone leaves S1 delivery and representation and S2 modeling unchanged.
Changing S1 or S2 evidence alone does not cascade into other checks or change Content, S3-S8 behavior.
Initial source evidence must not claim rendering or present hidden text, image-only text, or serialized state as ordinary visible text; robots does not block assessment.

Apply NA redistribution only within its criterion: remaining applicable weights are scaled to the criterion maximum; e.g. S1 configuration NA makes full delivery worth 4*13/11 and half delivery worth 2*13/11.
Missing an applicable measurement prevents a final score; an entirely excluded criterion also has no final score.
Preserve v1 historical results; v2 rubric and engine versions and cache identity are distinct; v1 API shape remains unchanged.
Bound source extraction and processing; truncation and unsupported inspection must not fabricate absence. Repeated extraction of identical bounded input is deterministic.
